set.smtpGmailHint: Gmail hia App Password, ɛnyɛ wo password a wode di dwuma daa no.
set.smtpGmailStep1: Klik Fa Gmail di dwuma wɔ ase hɔ — host, port 587, ne TLS hyɛ no ma ankasa.
set.smtpGmailStep2: Hyehyɛ wo Gmail mũ no nyinaa wɔ From email ne Username (e.g. you@gmail.com).
set.smtpGmailStep3: Dane 2-Step Verification wɔ wo Google Account mu, afei yɛ App Password. Fa saa password no di dwuma wɔ ha — ɛnyɛ wo Gmail password a wotaa yɛ no.

set.smtpGmailStep5: Klik Save wɔ kratafa yi atifi.

set.smtpWebStep1: Klik Fa Wɛbmail Di Dwuma wɔ aseɛ ha — Hostinger defaults hyehyɛ no ma ankasa (smtp.hostinger.com, port 465, SSL). Sesa host no sɛ wode provider foforo di dwuma a.
set.smtpWebStep2: Hostinger: ma port 465 no sie a TLS no adum (SSL). Wɔ ademafo afoforo fam no, port 587 + Fa TLS di dwuma no abu so.
set.smtpWebStep3: Hyɛ no ma Fi email, Fi din, edin a ɔde di dwuma (email a edi mũ), ne mailbox password.
set.smtpWebStep4: Klik Save wɔ kratafa yi atifi, afei fa sɔhwɛ krataa email mena.
